Relationships

customize.name: Nibelung
customize.desc: The leader of the elemental dragons and the primeval creator of Teyvat.

customize.text:
The Moons were created by the primordial creator and served the dragons. When Nibelung left Teyvat and traveled into the dark universe beyond, he left the rule of Teyvat to the Moon Goddesses.
During the War of Funerary Flame, the Moon Goddesses could not decide whom to support, so Nibelung decided that they had betrayed him and imprisoned the sisters, turning the Moons themselves into weapons.

customize.name: Heavenly Principles
customize.desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.text:
When the Heavenly Principles appeared in Teyvat, they made a peace treaty with the Moon Goddesses. During the War of the Funerary Flame, when the Nibelung turned the Moons into weapons, the Heavenly Principles shattered two Moons and sent the third one beyond the sky. From that moment on, the Goddesses ceased to belong to Teyvat.
Moon's Reflection
The space where Nibelung imprisoned Aria, Sonnet, and Canon, which can be opened by the Moon Gate. Time in this space flows in reverse. After Columbina received the powers of the Three Moons, the sisters became mortal, and Columbina was able to free them from their imprisonment. Since they no longer belonged to Teyvat, Aria and Canon perished, and Sonnet merged with the Abyss.

customize.text:
One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, obsessed with moons. His beloved Tholindis opened the Moon Gate. To bring her back from the space beyond the Moon Gate, he obtained the Abyssal power and reopened it to follow her. Within the space, an unknown force tore him apart, and only through the power of the Abyss did he survive.
When Rerir was sent back into the moon's reflection, the Abyss wanted to consume him, but he rejected it.

customize.name: The Doctor
customize.desc:
Reviled far and wide as a heretic, The Doctor — Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers — has seized the authority of the three moons and now ascends the long steps toward the divine throne of the "new world."
All should have belonged to us.
But reason cast out all that exceeded its limits, leaving humanity blind to its true nature.
Life and death bound us into mortal shells, shackling every spark of aspiration.
Time and space closed in last of all, fencing the mind into meek obedience, so no one would dare imagine breaking free.
From that point on, false gods governed the world, each one declaring their own truth as the sole, unassailable gospel — though none deserved the mantle they so loudly coveted.
There is no inherent structure to life's flow — order was merely imposed upon it. Strip away every shackle laid across this world, and the essence of all things will at last come into view.
And that revelation... is the first light of the new world.
"How much longer will you continue to suffer this stagnant, obsolescent world?"

The moon-blessed land located in the northwestern regions of Teyvat.

Follow the silver thread spun by the new moon, traverse biting gales and desolate tundras as the snow-kissed lakes, fractured like mirrors, reflect their ageless, glacial radiance. Tsurumi
The ancient civilization of Tsurumi worshipped the Moon Goddesses. When the civilization was destroyed, the "Boatman" took their souls to the golden hall on the Moon.

The Crimson Moon Dynasty worshipped the Crimson Moon and the Abyss through her. They used the Moon's shards to gain powers and created an orphanage to receive children from beyond the bounds of this world. The Crimson Moon sages looked beyond this world for beings with powers that surpassed the gods — the Descenders.

imgDesc.text:
Teyvat's three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.
When the Heavenly Principles came to Teyvat, they changed the world completely, down to its very foundations.
The moon goddesses were nowhere near strong enough to challenge this entity.
The Heavenly Principles did not view them as heretical entities that had to be removed, so the three moons continued to keep this planet alive and operational.

When Nibelung returned with forbidden knowledge from beyond the world, the war of funerary flame began.
Discord would soon emerge between the three moon sisters. One would voice the opinion that they should follow Nibelung, for it was he who first hung the moons in the sky.
Another would argue that taking sides in the conflict would only bring the world closer to ruin.
Nibelung would eventually discover their disloyalty. He had all three imprisoned before transforming the moons into weapons with which to fight against the Heavenly Principles.

The very moons that had once defended the planet became instruments of death and destruction, striking terror into the hearts of all living things.
And although the Heavenly Principles and the three moon sisters had once been at peace, it now seemed that the moons posed an unacceptable threat to Teyvat.
It is possible that the Heavenly Principles did not know of the goddesses' imprisonment. If so, the weaponization of the moons would surely have been viewed as an intentional breach of the peace agreement.
The Heavenly Principles shattered two moons, and flung the other beyond the skies.
When the "Eternal Moon" fell, the heavens and earth were thrown into chaos.
When the "Iridescent Moon" shattered, the crimson shadow sank into the abyssal sea.
When the "Frost Moon" ceased to turn, nations faltered and fell into ruin.
